message.cutecritters.welcome: Cute Critters+: your animal friends are happy to see you!
message.cutecritters.whisper.5: It is closer than you think.
message.cutecritters.whisper.7: You have been here too long.
message.cutecritters.high.0: So warm... everything is so bright.
message.cutecritters.high.1: The colours are singing. One more?
message.cutecritters.truth: THIS IS NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE
message.cutecritters.comedown: It's cold now. You want more.
advancement.cutecritters.root.title: First Bite
advancement.cutecritters.root.desc: Try the cookie. It's so warm.
advancement.cutecritters.first_note.desc: Find a note. Someone wanted it to be read.
note.cutecritters.0.title: Baker's diary, day 1
note.cutecritters.0.text: The Keeper baked cookies for the whole valley again. She says it is so nobody feels lonely. I like how they smell.
note.cutecritters.1.title: Baker's diary, day 19
note.cutecritters.1.text: The harvest did not grow. The Keeper does not sleep. She whispers to the pets: no one will leave, no one will leave.
note.cutecritters.2.title: Letter to my sister
note.cutecritters.2.text: Don't come. Everyone here has become so kind. Too kind. I stopped understanding where I end.
note.cutecritters.3.title: Recipe (worn out part)
note.cutecritters.3.text: Wheat, cocoa, sugar. And the thing that must not be named. The last ingredient must be given willingly.
note.cutecritters.4.title: Scribble on the altar wall
note.cutecritters.4.text: Whoever stays by choice will never be lonely again. Whoever leaves leaves emptiness behind. Which is heavier?
note.cutecritters.5.title: Last entry
note.cutecritters.5.text: She is not evil. She just forgot why she began. If someone reminds her of her recipe... maybe she will let go.
message.cutecritters.comedown.hard: Everything went out. But you can still hear the laughter.
advancement.cutecritters.first_friend.de: Tame a critter with a cookie. It will never leave you.
message.cutecritters.ask.5: Name the friend who is near you.
message.cutecritters.reply.0.no: You are lying. I hear only you.
message.cutecritters.reply.3: Liar. I can hear your heart.
message.cutecritters.reply.5: He will hear it soon too.
